subject: SpeedRunner ScienceWorld ASI replay/no-replay causal isolation
observations: The public replay config sets allow_replay=true and ScienceWorld task_id=[3], train_size=200, test_size=30, while the nearest public no-replay GPT config sets allow_replay=false and task_id=[3,4] with the same model/reasoning settings and per-family sizes.

ASISleep selects _ASI_SYSTEM_WITH_REPLAY when allow_replay=true and _ASI_SYSTEM_NO_REPLAY otherwise. The replay prompt requires a scripted test trajectory for every successful task and the replay condition registers submit_test_trajectory as an additional tool; the no-replay condition does not.

After proposal generation, allow_replay=false commits statically-valid new functions immediately. allow_replay=true instead requires a test trajectory for every successful task, executes each against a fresh environment, and reverts the proposed codebook if a replay fails or fails to use a newly-added helper; only all-pass proposals commit.

Therefore the current public allow_replay switch changes both proposal-generation context/output contract and post-proposal admission. It is not a candidate-bytes-frozen receiver/admission-only intervention.

The current public source tree starts from a parentless initial public release after the paper submission date, and public run/output directories are excluded from the repository tree; this public code cannot by itself bind Figure 12 to exact historical candidate bytes, replay transcripts, environment identity or raw numeric series.

inference.safe_claim: Current public SpeedRunner code demonstrates transactional replay admission, but its replay/no-replay switch is not causally isolated to admission because it also changes the induction prompt/tool contract. Figure-12 performance differences must not be promoted to evidence for a candidate-frozen admission-gate-only effect without historical run artifacts showing identical proposals across arms.
inference.forbidden_upgrade: Do not treat allow_replay=true vs false as same-candidate adopt-vs-reject or same-selected-identity receiver-effect-only evidence.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.note: This is an evidence/provenance audit of already-public artifacts; it does not claim the original experiment can be rerun quota-free.

exact_next_action: Search external public/supplementary SpeedRunner artifacts for the historical ScienceWorld Task-3 Figure-12 bundle: raw numeric series, exact candidate skill bytes for each replay decision, replay input scripts, environment/package/seed identity, and commit/revert transaction records. If absent, classify Figure 12 as system-level replay evidence only and continue the strongest causal search elsewhere.
